scope: Unmanned real single USB, native live recording, SDK and pose enabled; human left. Not human/dense-load calibration and not field root-cause trace.
protocol: Fresh process per condition, 20s formal, 8s between; three OFF/ON pairs per mode, pair order alternates. Original NumPy/renderer/queue observer, batch reference archive and SDK records retained. Empty calibration bypasses human gate explicitly and never asks a person to pass.
profile: ProcessThread, Loader, CSwitch, ReadyThread only. No stacks, CPU sampled profile, Python call tree, GIL or GC profiler. Unique WPR instance; never cancel a preexisting recording.
native_boundary_observers: Native GetThreadTimes for GUI/consumer/USB-reader at formal start/end plus two precise FILETIME/perf-counter clock brackets. No periodic CPU sampling.
primary_window: Formal 3..19 host seconds, to exclude arm/startup and stop. Native CPU snapshots span approximately whole 20s, separately labelled.
validity: All raw archives complete, contiguous device counters and no acquisition failures; actual raw video written, no writer drop, consumer/GUI threads different, one real reader, final queue empty and SDK closed. Usable contact <=1%; preserve original bad mask.
acceptance: All 6 pairs must have abs consumer-fps delta <=20; ON-OFF queue-head P95 increase <=20ms; preview fps ratio in [0.9,1.1], native recorded-frame fps ratio in [0.95,1.05]; consumer native CPU increase <=10% in each pair. ON traces must show scheduler keywords and zero losses. Retain every trial, no rerun-until-pass; failure or lack of margin is not passed calibration. Input-capped fps is not a capacity improvement.
limits: No human body/bone/dense contacts; possible background scene variations and process startup jitter. Even a pass only covers this light topology; field-load overhead still unvalidated. No under-load ETW/GIL/GC attribution this round.
